text:
What a madhouse, World; all things football, balls
and feet, are ranked up to the crest
of Aconcagua: a metaphor
for kicking for its own sake, or a display
of the leather of the Testicle
on the swollen grass, like this: Capital: it ejaculates and
makes whole stadiums ejaculate,
splattering rhetoric and grease
by satellite
in every language, Mayan,
even Etruscan?

To think
there were bullfighters, gladiators
in the contest, and rhythm.
Pindar
would have wept.

translation.title: Football Without End
